Cells are year–commodity–analyte groups; records and sample IDs are not interchangeable.
R0: reported magnitudes / limits. R1: fixed bins + ND limits. R2: status counts only.
Denominators are observed cells, not potential untested combinations. Missing codes are not non-detections.
Conditional reporting calculations; >10 ppb is a reporting probe, not a safety threshold or predictive validation.
